units.source_text: 我至今仍覺得，對年幼的孩童而言，做出這種事是人類所犯下的惡行中最為卑劣、最為醜惡、最為殘酷的罪孽。

en.t: Even now, I think that doing such a thing to a young child is the vilest, ugliest, and cruelest sin among the evils human beings commit.

units.source_text: 可我還是容忍了這一切，甚至還覺得自己看出了另一種人類的特質，我只能無力地苦笑。

en.t: Yet I endured it all, and even felt as if I had glimpsed another trait of human beings; all I could do was smile weakly and bitterly.

units.source_text: 倘若我有養成說真話的習慣，那麼，或許我會毫不膽怯地向父母控訴他們的罪行吧，

en.t: If I had formed the habit of telling the truth, perhaps I could have accused them of their crime before my parents without the slightest fear,

units.source_text: 但我又不完全瞭解自己的父母。

en.t: but I did not fully understand my own parents either.

units.source_text: 控訴他人的手段於我永遠是無法期待的。

en.t: The means of appealing against someone was something I could never place any hope in.

units.source_text: 無論是訴諸父母，還是訴諸警察，抑或政府，

en.t: Whether I appealed to my parents, to the police, or even to the government,

units.source_text: 最終不是仍然敗給那些老謀深算者的冠冕之詞嗎？

en.t: would I not in the end simply be defeated by the high-sounding excuses of those skilled in worldly calculation?

units.source_text: 世間的不公平是必然存在的，我十分清楚。

en.t: I knew perfectly well that unfairness in the world was inevitable.
